parameters.description: Global OS image stream for every machine in the cluster. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22 and gated by the OSStreams feature gate, which openshift/api enables only under TechPreviewNoUpgrade or DevPreviewNoUpgrade; openshift-install 4.22.16 rejects the field outright without that feature set. Red Hat documents RHEL 10 as a Technology Preview base image at 4.22, and Technology Preview is not covered by production service level agreements, so this is recorded for provenance rather than offered as a choice.
parameters.versionNotes: Introduced at 4.22 (pkg/types/installconfig.go InstallConfig.OSImageStream, enum rhel-9|rhel-10). Binary-verified rejection: "Forbidden: this field is protected by the OSStreams feature gate which must be enabled through either the TechPreviewNoUpgrade or CustomNoUpgrade feature set". Architect does not offer TechPreviewNoUpgrade, so emitting this field could only ever produce a rejected install-config. rhel-10 is additionally forbidden on SCOS/OKD builds.

parameters.description: IP address family for the cluster network on AWS. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22. Red Hat documents AWS dual-stack networking as a Technology Preview at 4.22, which is not supported under production service level agreements, so neither dual-stack value is offered; IPv4, the only non-dual-stack value, is what the installer applies when the field is absent.
parameters.versionNotes: Introduced at 4.22 (pkg/types/aws/platform.go Platform.IPFamily). The dual-stack values are gated by AWSDualStackInstall; binary-verified rejection: "Forbidden: this field is protected by the AWSDualStackInstall feature gate", plus "when installing dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 you must provide two service networks". The 4.22 release-note Technology Preview entry names AWS and does not address AWS GovCloud, which is the region family Architect models; the disposition is unaffected because Technology Preview is not exposed either way. This field also governs the conditional default of platform.aws.lbType — because it is never emitted, lbType always resolves to Classic.

parameters.description: AWS Dedicated Host placement for control-plane machines. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22 and documented by Red Hat as a Technology Preview, which is not supported under production service level agreements.
parameters.versionNotes: Introduced at 4.22 (pkg/types/aws/machinepool.go MachinePool.HostPlacement), gated by AWSDedicatedHosts, which openshift/api enables only under TechPreviewNoUpgrade or DevPreviewNoUpgrade. Binary-verified rejection: "Forbidden: this field is protected by the AWSDedicatedHosts feature gate". Sub-fields affinity (enum DedicatedHost|AnyAvailable, union discriminator) and dedicatedHost[].id (19 characters, h- followed by 17 lowercase hex) are recorded here rather than as separate rows because Architect models no structure beneath this object. The 4.22 release-note Technology Preview entry names AWS and does not state AWS GovCloud applicability.

parameters.description: Machine-management API for control-plane machines. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22 and absent from Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.22 documentation, including the Technology Preview tables.
parameters.versionNotes: Introduced at 4.22 (pkg/types/machinepools.go MachinePool.Management, +kubebuilder:default=ClusterAPI), gated by ClusterAPIControlPlaneInstall, which openshift/api enables under DevPreviewNoUpgrade only — not even TechPreviewNoUpgrade. Binary-verified rejection: "controlPlane.management: Forbidden: this field is protected by the ClusterAPIControlPlaneInstall feature gate". The gate fires only when the value is explicitly set; an omitted field defaults to ClusterAPI later in the pipeline without tripping it, so omitting is both correct and safe. The installer doc comment says "Supported platforms: aws".

parameters.description: Machine-management API for compute machines. NOT EXPOSED by OpenShift Airgap Architect and never emitted. New at OpenShift 4.22 and absent from Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.22 documentation, including the Technology Preview tables.

The gate fires only when the value is explicitly set; an omitted field defaults to ClusterAPI later in the pipeline without tripping it, so omitting is both correct and safe.
